facts.value: Insight Enterprises, Inc., through Reef Acquisition Co.
Strategic: Fortune 500 global provider of IT hardware, software, cloud and services
Bidder-led: Party A unsolicited $10.00 cash proposal, 01/19/2016
Met (process 1): 23 parties (10 strategic and 13 financial NDA signers)

facts.field: Currency and units of bid prices

facts.value: Party A, a strategic buyer, proposed $10.00 per share in cash in January 2016 and later offered $10.30-$10.75 subject to financing, which the board declined in April. In June Raymond James contacted 27 strategic and financial parties, 23 signed NDAs, and ten indications were considered in late July, of which five advanced. Final proposals in late August came from Insight, Party B and Party C, and Insight raised to $12.00 and received 30 days of exclusivity on 09/02/2016. When Insight insisted on pro forma 8-K requirements, the board let exclusivity lapse and re-approached Parties B and C; Party B later withdrew and Party C held at $11.25. Insight regained exclusivity on 10/26/2016, cut its price to $11.00 after third-quarter results, accepted a $11.25 counter, and signed on 11/06/2016.

findings.title: Austin's ruling: January bilateral stage is round 1
findings.detail: A 21 September audit of an earlier Datalink draft asked whether E6's ordering puts round 1 at the June 6 outreach, leaving Party A's pre-June activity in a round 0. Austin ruled to retain January's bilateral stage as round 1 and June's broad outreach as round 2, with five rounds overall. January 29 remains an inferred opening date. The adjudication calls this a case-level mapping decision, not an instruction change.
